Mission Local’s November 29, 2024 story highlighted election turnout, the shift to even-year elections, and voting patterns on Proposition K. It reported that about 412,000 people voted—38,000 fewer than in 2020 despite a similar number of registered voters—and that Proposition K passed citywide by 55–45, even though voters in districts nearer the Great Highway opposed it overwhelmingly.
